title: Mechanisms of Tianma Gouteng Yin in Treating Hypertension-Associated Vascular Cognitive Impairment: Insights from Experiments, Network Pharmacology, and Molecular Docking.
authors: Li, Na-Chuan; Du, Ya-Wei; Zhang, Hong-Xiao; Zhao, Fan-Ying; Yi, Liu-Feng; Wang, Xiang-Zhao; Liu, Zi-Wang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药天麻钩藤饮治疗高血压相关血管性认知障碍的网络药理学与分子对接，对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate active components of Tianma Gouteng Yin (TMGTY) and its mechanisms in treating hypertension-associated vascular cognitive impairment (VCI). METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to identify major active ingredients and potential targets of TMGTY in treating hypertension-associated VCI. An in vivo model was established using spontaneously hypertensive rats subjected to unilateral common carotid artery occlusion and a high-salt diet. Rats were randomly divided into 7 groups by a simple randomization method: control, model, sham, low-, medium-, and high-dose TMGTY, and nimodipine groups (n=6). After 28 days of oral administration, blood pressure, behavioral studies, pathological staining, and molecular mechanisms were assessed via tail artery blood pressure monitoring, the morris water maze test, HE staining, immunofluorescence staining, ELISA, and Western blotting. RESULTS: Network analysis identified quercetin, kaempferol, beta-sitosterol, and stigmasterol as key ingredients. Pathway enrichment analysis identified the NF-kappaB signaling pathway as a key pathway through which TMGTY antagonizes the development of hypertension combined with VCI. Core targets included glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH), interleukin 6 (IL-6), insulin (INS), tumor necrosis factor (TNF), and tumor protein p53 (TP53), and molecular docking confirmed stable binding to TNF and INS. In vivo experiments demonstrated that TMGTY significantly enhanced cognitive performance and reduced blood pressure. Furthermore, it lowered the levels of pro-inflammatory factors (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha, Ang-II) and malondialdehyde (MDA), while elevating superoxide dismutase (SOD) expression (P<0.05 or P<0.01). Immunofluorescence staining further revealed that TMGTY treatment reduced the number of Iba1- and CD16-labeled microglia in the hippocampal CA1 region, thereby alleviating neuroinflammation. Additionally, TMGTY inhibited the expression levels of p-NF-kappaB p65/NF-kappaB p65 proteins and attenuated neuroinflammation. CONCLUSION: TMGTY exerts multi-component, multi-target effects on hypertension-associated VCI, mitigating neuroinflammation and oxidative stress via modulation of NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：评估天麻钩藤饮（TMGTY）的活性成分及其治疗高血压相关血管性认知障碍（VCI）的机制。方法：采用网络药理学和分子对接技术，鉴定TMGTY治疗高血压相关VCI的主要活性成分和潜在靶点。通过单侧颈总动脉闭塞联合高盐饮食建立自发性高血压大鼠体内模型。采用简单随机化方法将大鼠随机分为7组（每组n=6）：对照组、模型组、假手术组、TMGTY低剂量组、中剂量组、高剂量组和尼莫地平组。口服给药28天后，通过尾动脉血压监测、Morris水迷宫试验、HE染色、免疫荧光染色、ELISA和Western blotting评估血压、行为学、病理染色及分子机制。结果：网络分析鉴定出槲皮素、山柰酚、β-谷甾醇和豆甾醇为关键成分。通路富集分析确定NF-kappaB信号通路为TMGTY拮抗高血压合并VCI发展的关键通路。核心靶点包括甘油醛-3-磷酸脱氢酶（GAPDH）、白细胞介素6（IL-6）、胰岛素（INS）、肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）和肿瘤蛋白p53（TP53），分子对接证实其与TNF和INS稳定结合。体内实验表明，TMGTY显著增强认知功能并降低血压。此外，它降低了促炎因子（IL-1beta、IL-6、TNF-alpha、Ang-II）和丙二醛（MDA）水平，同时升高超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）表达（P<0.05或P<0.01）。免疫荧光染色进一步显示，TMGTY治疗减少了海马CA1区Iba1和CD16标记的小胶质细胞数量，从而减轻神经炎症。此外，TMGTY抑制p-NF-kappaB p65/NF-kappaB p65蛋白的表达水平，并减弱神经炎症。结论：TMGTY对高血压相关VCI发挥多组分、多靶点效应，通过调节NF-kappaB信号通路减轻神经炎症和氧化应激。
